title: crew-for-claude skills-config
description: Project configuration for the crew skills and workflows. Lives at .claude/skills-config.json. Generated by /install or /bootstrap-skills; hand-editable.

issueTracker.description: Where issues live, consumed by draft-prd / slice-issues / sort-issues / troubleshoot.

packs.description: Activation flag per pack. true = wired into hooks/settings. Keys are pack ids (e.g. python-fastapi, java, node, go).

verify.description: The 2-D language x class verify map.

byRepo.description: Per-repo language/class pin + command overrides. Key = repo name.

attributionTrailer.description: The exact Co-Authored-By trailer allowed in git commit messages and gh commands. Defaults to empty string (attribution enforcement is OFF by default). When set to a non-empty value, the block-claude-attribution and check-commit-msg hooks activate and allow only this exact trailer (or no trailer at all). Hardcoded banned vendor/model terms (Claude, Anthropic, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, 'Generated with') are blocked when the hook is active.

crossTeamRequestDir.description: Directory path where cross-team request artifacts are stored. Default: 'plan/cross-team/'.

crossTeamLabels.description: Array of team labels used for cross-team requests. Default: ['team:devops', 'team:backend', 'team:frontend'].
